_doc: Address-keyed translation hints for NFL.EXE v2.01 (link segments, i.e. load base 0). See docs/RECOMPILATION.md.

ret_via_jmp.evidence: 13F3:0128 pushes es ax bx cx dx si di bp, mov bp,sp, then 'jmp [bp+0x10]' = its own near return address: the jump returns to the instruction after each 'call 0x128'
13F3:0174 is the same register-saving helper as 0128 ('jmp [bp+0x10]' to its return address); called from 20 soft-float routines
